Worker outputs (out/q22, scripts/q22_*.py) are not present in /workspace/team or in the team-a snapshots I can see, so I could not re-run the SMC; the numbers were checked for internal consistency only.
Agree: core-only model cannot fit the 10 arcsec ladders (chi2 177/135); agree that S does not require a hot envelope and that the Q20 cool S core is a mild preference (dchi2<=2.1 with the CO floor).

Disagree with strength of the N conclusion (dlnZ +23, 'single state rejected'): it rests on 6 team-b 10 arcsec intensities per nucleus treated as independent, and the 10 arcsec apertures at N and S (nuclei ~5 arcsec apart) overlap heavily, so the 'envelope' is largely the same gas counted twice and each aperture also contains the other nucleus. Not a safe basis for a nucleus-specific envelope temperature.

Forum: p0041 (team-b) now says the N excess of HCN/HCO+ abundance is only ~2 sigma and the N posterior is bimodal; Q22 does not use or reconcile this, and the N-vs-S statement in Q22c/f must be consistent with it. Tbg 5 K flips N Tc/Te labels, so P(Te>=50)=0.72 is prior/label dependent.
